Retained native Linux ARM64 profile only; legacy root/buildSrc/Thrift/JMH/DI/HTTP stacks, other platforms, production HA and rolling migration remain outside this gate.

Compatibility uses private snapshots: bidirectional Job/Run/Stop writes/replay/rollback; new-stack snapshots reopen on both stacks. Reverse old-stack writes reopen on new without a further snapshot. PKCS12 load/init only; no TLS handshake or keystore rewrite in this harness.
Actual TLS handshakes, API operations and process recovery are covered separately by HTTP tests and the physical cluster gates.
Static JDK analysis does not exhaustively detect reflection. Optional missing edges belong to excluded validator features and SQLite Graal native-image integration.
Performance results are exploratory sequential Pi trials with the same instrumentation and resource limits, not a production SLO or significance claim.
Java artifacts/installed content reproduce; identical Docker image rebuild IDs are not claimed.
